summary: Market tone looks broadly risk-on for crypto, with multiple analysts still favoring altcoins over Bitcoin and looking for continuation in selected names. The freshest accessible items here point to bullish interest in BTC, ETH, SOL, JUP, ONDO, NEAR, and TAO, while macro commentary remains mixed but not clearly risk-off.
